secrets.name: Mission Control session secret
secrets.purpose: Signs session cookies. Replace this placeholder with the BWS secret ID.
secrets.rotation_notes: Replacing the value signs out every session. Restart the service after changing it in BWS.

secrets.name: Mission Control API key
secrets.purpose: Authenticates agent and CLI clients. Replace this placeholder with the BWS secret ID.
secrets.rotation_notes: Update the matching MC_API_KEY entry used by the CLI manifest, then restart the service.
